description: Blur effects and visual emphasis techniques for clips

background_blur.purpose: Focus viewer attention on the subject when source is 16:9 and we crop to 9:16
background_blur.how_to: When cropping 16:9 to 9:16, the edges are blurred to fill the vertical frame
background_blur.when_to_use: Always when converting landscape footage to vertical format
background_blur.intensity: Moderate (not too strong, not too weak)

zoom_blur_transition.purpose: Dynamic transition between clips or moments
zoom_blur_transition.how_to: Zoom in quickly with motion blur on the transition
zoom_blur_transition.when_to_use: Between ranking segments, on punchlines, on reaction moments

depth_of_field_blur.purpose: Simulate professional camera depth of field
depth_of_field_blur.when_to_use: On talking head segments, interviews, reactions

moment_emphasis_blur.purpose: Draw attention to a specific moment or reaction
moment_emphasis_blur.how_to: Slight vignette + blur edges, keep center sharp
moment_emphasis_blur.when_to_use: On key moments, punchlines, controversial statements

overlay_blur.purpose: Show B-roll or image overlay while keeping audio context
overlay_blur.how_to: Extract audio from original clip, add image/video overlay on top
overlay_blur.capcut_method: Extract audio → Add overlay → Position on timeline
overlay_blur.when_to_use: When illustrating a point, showing evidence, adding visual context
overlay_blur.note_from_transcript: BOAU (Behind And Overlay) = overlay technique. Show picture/video while voice continues.
